paragraphs.en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents for automated program repair, patching software vulnerabilities through multi-step reasoning and tool use. Yet these systems typically validate a patch against the same evidence used to construct it—a static alert, sanitizer trace, published exploit, or test suite. A patch that blocks that one piece of evidence can therefore look successful while remaining vulnerable to the same vulnerability with some variation. We present P2Patch , a generative adversarial repair system that treats each patch as a new attack target. Starting from a normalized vulnerability finding, an exploitation agent constructs a reproducing proof of vulnerability (PoV), a patching agent repairs the program, and the exploitation agent then attacks the patched program for a distinct same-vulnerability exploit. Every successful exploit becomes a permanent repair requirement, and the final patch must block all PoVs accumulated during patching process, with construction-time PoVs kept strictly separate from held-out evaluation oracles. Across 101 C/C++ and Java CVE subjects, this adversarial loop surfaces a distinct confirmed exploit in 41% of runs after the patch has already blocked its original construction-time PoV. Against single-pass repair from the same finding using Claude Code, P2Patch raises held-out fix-closed coverage from 78.1% to 84.7% and beyond-upstream coverage from 42.1% to 62.5%. Under the same held-out oracles, it also certifies more attack paths as blocked than recent state-of-the-art agentic repair systems on overlapping subjects. These results show that adversarial testing and independent security oracles expose repair gaps that one-shot validation misses.

paragraphs.en: Automated vulnerability repair is only as reliable as the evidence used to guide and judge it. A static-analysis alert identifies a suspicious flow, but not necessarily the runtime conditions that make it exploitable [ 25 , 27 ] . A sanitizer trace or proof of concept—an input that triggers a specific bug or flaw within a program—demonstrates one failing execution, but not every similar payload, encoding, entry point, or sibling path that should be blocked. A project test suite may preserve intended functionality, but it rarely defines the full security boundary. These signals are valuable but partial: they can explain why a revision merits repair without specifying what a complete repair must cover [ 21 , 36 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 自动化漏洞修复的可靠性完全取决于用于指导与判断其过程所依据的证据。 静态分析警报可以识别出可疑的流程，但未必能确定使其可被利用的运行时条件 [ 25 , 27 ] 。 净化器追踪或概念验证——即能够触发程序中特定错误或缺陷的输入——只能证明存在一种失败的执行路径，而无法涵盖所有应当被阻止的类似有效载荷、编码、入口点或相邻路径。 项目的测试套件或许能保留预期功能，但很少能定义完整的安全边界。 这些信号虽有价值却并不全面：它们可以解释为何某个修订版本需要修复，却无法明确完整的修复必须涵盖哪些内容 [ 21 , 36 ] 。

paragraphs.en: These partial signals create an oracle-reuse problem. Automated repair systems often use one piece of evidence twice: first to guide patch construction, and then to decide whether the patch succeeded. A patch that blocks the supplied PoV, crashing input, sanitizer trace, or available test may therefore be accepted even if it only specializes to that evidence. This risk is well known in general program repair, where test-guided repair can overfit its construction suite [ 52 , 66 , 33 , 15 ] . It is especially consequential for security repair: blocking one observed attack can be mistaken for resolving the underlying security issue. Recent vulnerability-repair evaluations likewise show that proof-of-concept plus functional-test validation can overestimate repair correctness [ 72 , 58 , 60 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这些部分信号造成了一个“神谕重用”问题。 自动化修复系统通常会重复使用一条证据：首先用它指导补丁的构建，然后用它判断补丁是否成功。 因此，一个仅针对该证据进行特化的补丁，即使它阻止了所提供的概念验证、崩溃输入、净化器跟踪或可用测试，也可能被接受。 这种风险在通用程序修复领域早已为人所知，其中基于测试的修复方法可能会对其构建套件产生过拟合 [ 52 , 66 , 33 , 15 ] 。 这对安全修复尤其具有重大影响：阻止一次观察到的攻击可能会被误认为解决了根本的安全问题。 近期的漏洞修复评估同样表明，概念验证加上功能测试验证可能会高估修复的正确性 [ 72 , 58 , 60 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Existing vulnerability-repair systems occupy several points in this design space. Some patch from vulnerable code, weakness semantics, and suspected locations, while others use crashing inputs, sanitizer reports, proofs of concept, or trace-derived triggers for localization, repair, and validation [ 45 , 13 , 74 , 71 , 29 , 76 , 26 , 51 , 55 ] . LoopRepair further iterates on vulnerable locations and taint-trace feedback [ 68 ] . These systems show that dynamic evidence and LLM agents can improve vulnerability repair, but their repair objective is typically fixed before patching begins: the system attempts to satisfy the same alert, crash, trace, or PoV after each repair attempt. The target does not adapt to the patched program.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的漏洞修复系统在该设计空间中占据了多个位置。 一些系统从易受攻击的代码、弱点语义和疑似位置中提取补丁，而另一些系统则使用导致崩溃的输入、净化器报告、概念验证或源自追踪的触发机制来进行定位、修复和验证 [ 45 , 13 , 74 , 71 , 29 , 76 , 26 , 51 , 55 ] 。 LoopRepair 进一步对易受攻击的位置和污染追踪反馈进行迭代 [ 68 ] 。 这些系统表明，动态证据和 LLM 智能体能够提升漏洞修复效果，但它们的修复目标通常在开始打补丁前就已固定：系统在每次修复尝试后都会试图满足相同的警报、崩溃、追踪或概念验证。 目标不会根据已打补丁的程序进行调整。

paragraphs.en: We argue that vulnerability repair should be exploit-guided . Once a patch changes the program, the relevant question is not only whether the original PoV is blocked, but whether a distinct exploit can falsify the security claim that accepting the current patch implies. A path-traversal patch that rejects one relative path may still accept an absolute path; an injection patch that blocks one payload may miss an alternate encoding; a repair at one sink may leave a sibling sink reachable. In these cases, the next useful evidence is not another explanation of the original bug, but a working same-vulnerability exploit against the current patch. This framing resembles counterexample-guided synthesis, but our verifier is an incomplete, budgeted exploiter rather than a complete decision procedure [ 54 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，漏洞修复应以利用方式为指导。 一旦补丁修改了程序，相关的问题不仅在于原有的攻击路径是否被阻断，还在于是否存在一种不同的利用方式能够推翻接受当前补丁所隐含的安全主张。 一个路径穿越补丁可能拒绝一条相对路径，但仍会接受绝对路径；一个注入补丁可能阻止一种有效载荷，却可能忽略另一种替代编码；对某个汇点的修复可能仍会使另一个相邻汇点保持可达状态。 在这些情况下，下一个有用的证据并非对原始漏洞的另一种解释，而是针对当前补丁的一种能够成功利用相同漏洞的攻击方式。 这种框架类似于以反例为指导的合成方法，但我们的验证器是一个不完整且受资源限制的利用程序，而非一个完整的决策过程 [ 54 ]。

paragraphs.en: This paper presents P2Patch , an execution-refereed exploit–patch repair system. We call this exploit-guided repair: a security instantiation of counterexample-guided synthesis in which the counterexample is an executable exploit against the current patch rather than a logical model [ 54 , 11 ] . P2Patch starts from a normalized vulnerability finding and a pinned project revision. The protocol is evidence-source independent: the finding may come from a static alert or source-to-sink trace [ 3 ] , a vulnerability description, a sanitizer report, or a successful exploitation. Our evaluation uses source-to-sink traces, with all findings redacted so that agents do not receive the CVE identifier, upstream fix, advisory exploit text, or held-out proofs of vulnerability (PoVs). Existing work has studied LLM-assisted static analysis and PoV generation as upstream capabilities [ 37 , 44 , 14 , 56 , 35 ] . P2Patch uses such evidence differently: an exploitation agent (the exploiter ) turns the finding into a reproducing PoV, a patching agent (the patcher ) modifies the program until that PoV is blocked, and the exploiter then attacks the patched program for a new distinct same-vulnerability PoV that bypasses the patch. Every execution-confirmed bypassing PoV becomes a permanent repair requirement.

sents.zh: 该协议独立于证据来源：发现结果可能来自静态警报或源到目标追踪 [3]、漏洞描述、净化器报告，或成功的漏洞利用。

sents.en: Our evaluation uses source-to-sink traces, with all findings redacted so that agents do not receive the CVE identifier, upstream fix, advisory exploit text, or held-out proofs of vulnerability (PoVs).
sents.zh: 我们的评估使用了源到目标追踪，并对所有发现结果进行了脱敏处理，使得智能体无法获取 CVE 标识符、上游修复方案、建议的漏洞利用文本或预留的漏洞证明（PoVs）。

sents.en: Existing work has studied LLM-assisted static analysis and PoV generation as upstream capabilities [ 37 , 44 , 14 , 56 , 35 ] .
sents.zh: 现有研究已探讨了 LLM 辅助静态分析和漏洞证明生成作为上游能力的应用 [37, 44, 14, 56, 35]。

sents.en: P2Patch uses such evidence differently: an exploitation agent (the exploiter ) turns the finding into a reproducing PoV, a patching agent (the patcher ) modifies the program until that PoV is blocked, and the exploiter then attacks the patched program for a new distinct same-vulnerability PoV that bypasses the patch.
sents.zh: P2Patch 以不同方式使用这些证据：一个漏洞利用智能体（攻击者）将发现结果转化为可复现的漏洞证明；一个打补丁的智能体（修复者）修改程序直到该漏洞证明被阻断；随后攻击者再次攻击已打补丁的程序，生成一个新的、不同的但属于同一漏洞的漏洞证明，从而绕过补丁。

sents.en: Every execution-confirmed bypassing PoV becomes a permanent repair requirement.
sents.zh: 每一个经执行验证成功绕过的漏洞证明都会成为一项永久性的修复要求。

paragraphs.en: The design is execution-mediated. Agents may propose PoVs and patches, but they do not certify success [ 77 ] . The orchestrator executes PoVs in the project container, distinguishes reproduction, blocking, and inconclusive infrastructure outcomes, runs differential regression checks, protects role-specific artifacts, and replays accumulated hardening PoVs after the adversarial rounds. Thus, the interaction is a bounded repair process over a changing executable program, not a natural-language debate between agents.
paragraphs.zh: 该设计由执行过程所中介。 智能体可以提出观点（PoV）和补丁，但它们并不认证成功 [ 77 ] 。 协调器在项目容器中执行观点（PoV），区分基础设施的重现、阻塞和无结论结果，运行差异回归检查，保护特定角色的产物，并在对抗回合结束后重演累积的加固观点（PoV）。 因此，这种互动是在一个不断变化的可执行程序上进行的有限修复过程，而非智能体之间的自然语言辩论。

paragraphs.en: P2Patch separates construction-time evidence from evaluation-time evidence. Live PoVs drive repair, but we do not treat them as an independent measure of completeness to avoid the oracle-reuse problem. We instead evaluate final patches with independently certified and held-out PoV suites. Fix-closed PoVs reproduce on the vulnerable revision and are blocked by the recorded official fix, measuring held-out attack-path coverage. Residual PoVs reproduce both before and after the official fix, measuring beyond-upstream hardening. This distinction matters because released security patches can themselves be incomplete [ 34 , 69 ] .
paragraphs.zh: P2Patch 将构建时的证据与评估时的证据分离开来。 实时 PoV 会触发修复，但我们不会将其视为完整性的独立衡量标准，以避免“预言机重复使用”问题。 相反，我们通过独立认证且预留的 PoV 套件来评估最终补丁。 已修复的 PoV 会在脆弱修订版本上重现，但会被记录在案的官方修复所阻止，从而衡量预留攻击路径的覆盖范围。 残留的 PoV 在官方修复前后都会重现，从而衡量超越上游的加固效果。 这种区分很重要，因为已发布的安全补丁本身也可能不完整 [ 34 , 69 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate P2Patch on 101 project-level CVE subjects spanning C/C++ and Java. The exploiter finds a distinct execution-confirmed bypass in 41% of runs after the patch blocks its original PoV. Against single-pass repair from the same finding, P2Patch raises held-out fix-closed coverage from 78.1% to 84.7% and beyond-upstream coverage from 42.1% to 62.5%. Fourteen certified residual gaps were later closed upstream, up to nine and a half years after the original fix. Under the same held-out oracles, P2Patch covers more certified attack paths than published repair systems on overlapping subjects and exposes patches that passed their validation while leaving certified paths open.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在涵盖 C/C++ 和 Java 的 101 个项目级 CVE 样本上对 P2Patch 进行了评估。 在补丁阻止了原始攻击视角后，攻击工具在 41% 的运行中找到了一个明确经执行验证的绕过方法。 与来自同一发现的单次修复相比，P2Patch 将保留的已修复覆盖范围从 78.1% 提升至 84.7%，并将上游之外的覆盖范围从 42.1% 提升至 62.5%。 后来，在原始修复完成的最长九点五年后，十四处经认证的残留漏洞最终在上游得到了修复。 在相同的保留验证集下，P2Patch 在重叠样本上覆盖的经认证攻击路径比已发布的修复系统更多，并揭示了那些通过验证但仍有经认证路径开放的补丁。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We introduce a counterexample-guided exploit–patch protocol in which each execution-confirmed bypass of the current patch becomes a permanent repair requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种由反例引导的漏洞利用–补丁协议，其中每次经执行确认的当前补丁绕过行为都会成为一项永久性的修复要求。

paragraphs.en: We design an execution-mediated orchestrator that separates exploiter and patcher roles, protects role-specific artifacts, distinguishes blocked exploits from inconclusive outcomes, performs differential regression checks, and replays accumulated PoVs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一种执行中介式协调器，它将利用者和修补者的角色分离开来，保护各角色的特定产物，区分被阻断的利用尝试与结果不确定的情况，执行差异回归检查，并重新播放累积的观点（PoVs）。

paragraphs.en: We release VulnRepairBench , a benchmark of 101 project–CVE subjects whose independently certified fix-closed and residual PoV suites separate held-out attack-path coverage from beyond-upstream hardening.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发布了 VulnRepairBench，这是一个包含 101 个项目–CVE 样本的基准测试。这些样本经过独立认证的修复关闭和残留观点套件，能够将预留的攻击路径覆盖与上游之外的加固措施区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate P2Patch across C/C++ and Java CVE subjects against a single-pass baseline, loop ablations, model variants, and published repair systems, showing that adaptive counterexample growth improves security coverage and exposes gaps missed by conventional validation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 C/C++ 和 Java 的 CVE 主题上，将 P2Patch 与单遍基线、循环消融、模型变体以及已发布的修复系统进行了评估。结果表明，自适应反例增长能够提升安全覆盖范围，并揭示传统验证所遗漏的漏洞。

paragraphs.en: P2Patch studies repair after a vulnerability has already been reported. Given a pinned vulnerable revision P 0 P_{0} , a normalized finding f f , and a project execution contract 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , the task is to produce either a source patch π \pi or a structured failure. A patch is construction-valid only if the patched program P 0 ⊕ π P_{0}\oplus\pi (the pinned revision with π \pi applied) blocks all live PoVs accumulated during the protocol and does not introduce a differential regression under 𝒞 \mathcal{C} . Final security coverage is measured later by held-out PoV suites; P2Patch is blind to these during repair.
paragraphs.zh: P2Patch 的研究是在漏洞已被报告之后进行修复的。 给定一个已固定的脆弱版本 P₀、一个归一化的发现 f，以及一个项目执行合同 𝒞，该任务需要生成一个源补丁 π 或一个结构化失败结果。 一个补丁仅在以下情况下是构造有效的：经过打补丁的程序 P₀⊕π（即应用了 π 的固定版本）能够阻止协议期间累积的所有活跃 PoV，并且在 𝒞 下不会引入差异性的回归问题。 最终的安全覆盖范围将在之后通过预留的 PoV 套件进行衡量；P2Patch 在修复过程中无法感知这些套件。

paragraphs.en: We study repair, not triage [ 18 ] . Each subject corresponds to a reported CVE, and the normalized finding is assumed to describe the target vulnerability. The system receives the weakness class, relevant source locations, suspected source-to-sink or trigger context when available, and build/execution metadata. It does not receive the CVE identifier, upstream patch, advisory exploit text, or curated evaluation PoVs. This setup evaluates whether a repair protocol can turn partial vulnerability evidence into executable repair requirements, not whether an agent can retrieve or copy the recorded fix.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究的是修复，而非分类处理 [ 18 ]。 每个主题都对应一个已报告的 CVE，并且假设标准化后的发现结果能够描述目标漏洞。 该系统接收漏洞类别、相关的源代码位置、可用的疑似源到汇或触发上下文，以及构建/执行元数据。 它不会接收 CVE 标识符、上游补丁、建议性利用文本或经过筛选的评估观点。 这种设置旨在评估修复协议是否能够将部分漏洞证据转化为可执行的修复需求，而非评估智能体能否获取或复制已记录的修复方法。

paragraphs.en: The example shows a gap between two questions a repair system can confuse: whether a patch stops the attack it was shown, and whether it repairs the boundary that attack crossed. paragraphs.en: The evidence available for a vulnerability determines what a repair system can be asked to do. A sanitizer report plus a crashing input is precise and executable, but it exists only for failures a sanitizer or crash oracle can observe. A static finding is broader, covering injection, traversal, authorization, deserialization, and other non-crashing weaknesses. On its own, though, it neither proves reachability nor defines the observable security effect [ 65 ] . P2Patch consumes the latter form and turns it into live PoVs.
paragraphs.zh: 可用证据的充分性决定了修复系统可以被要求执行哪些操作。 消毒器报告加上导致崩溃的输入是精确且可执行的，但它仅适用于消毒器或崩溃预言机能够观察到的故障。 静态发现的范围更广，涵盖了注入、遍历、授权、反序列化以及其他非崩溃类弱点。 然而，仅凭这一点既无法证明可达性，也无法定义可观察的安全影响 [ 65 ] 。 P2Patch 消耗后一种形式，并将其转化为实际的 POV。

paragraphs.en: A proof of vulnerability (PoV) is an input or test driver plus an execution command whose outcome is one of three values: reproduced, blocked, or inconclusive. A PoV is live when the exploiter produces it during a run, so that it becomes a repair requirement; it is held-out when it is authored outside the loop and used only to score the final patch. A valid PoV must exercise a real product entry point and observe the relevant security effect. Source inspection, attacker-controlled assertions, missing harnesses, timeouts, and build failures are not evidence that a vulnerability is blocked. The inconclusive outcome is therefore essential: without it, broken infrastructure can be mistaken for successful repair.
paragraphs.zh: 漏洞证明（PoV）是一种输入或测试驱动程序，加上一个执行命令，其结果可能为三种值之一：复现、被阻断或无法确定。 当攻击者在运行过程中生成 PoV 时，该 PoV 即处于“活跃”状态，从而成为修复要求；若它在循环外部编写且仅用于评估最终补丁，则属于“预留”状态。 有效的 PoV 必须触发产品的真实入口点，并观察到相关的安全影响。 源代码检查、攻击者控制的断言、缺失的测试框架、超时和构建失败均不能作为漏洞已被阻断的证据。 因此，“无法确定”的结果至关重要：若没有这一结果，有缺陷的基础设施可能会被误认为已成功修复。

paragraphs.en: A PoV is both narrower and stronger than the original finding. It is narrower because it demonstrates one path, payload, and environment. It is stronger because it converts a suspected vulnerability into an executable predicate that can be replayed before and after patching. The repair objective starts from such predicates and grows only when execution confirms another in-scope bypass.
paragraphs.zh: 一种 PoV 既比原始发现更狭窄，也更强大。 它之所以更狭窄，是因为它展示了一条特定的路径、有效载荷和环境。 它之所以更强大，是因为它将一个疑似漏洞转换为了一个可执行的谓词，该谓词可以在打补丁前后重复执行。 修复目标始于此类谓词，并且只有当执行确认存在另一个范围内的绕过时才会扩展。

sents.en: A PoV is both narrower and stronger than the original finding.
sents.zh: 一种 PoV 既比原始发现更狭窄，也更强大。

sents.en: It is narrower because it demonstrates one path, payload, and environment.
sents.zh: 它之所以更狭窄，是因为它展示了一条特定的路径、有效载荷和环境。

paragraphs.en: The repair objective is not fixed to the first PoV. When execution confirms a new bypass of the current patch, that bypass becomes an additional repair requirement that later patches must continue to block. New requirements must exercise the same reported weakness and security boundary, although they may use different payloads, encodings, entry points, or sibling paths.
paragraphs.zh: 修复目标并非固定于第一个视角。 当执行过程确认存在绕过当前补丁的新方法时，该绕过方式将成为一项额外的修复要求，后续补丁必须持续阻止它。 新的要求必须针对已报告的相同弱点和安全边界进行测试，尽管它们可能使用不同的有效载荷、编码、入口点或兄弟路径。

paragraphs.en: This structure resembles counterexample-guided synthesis, but the analogy is methodological rather than formal [ 1 ] . The verifier is a bounded exploiter, not a complete decision procedure over all inputs [ 8 , 22 ] . “No counterexample found” therefore means only that the configured search failed to find another reproducing same-vulnerability bypass. Independent held-out suites in Section 4 measure the final patch after repair terminates.
paragraphs.zh: 这种结构与反例引导的合成方法相似，但这种类比属于方法论上的而非形式上的 [ 1 ] 。 验证器是一个有界的利用者，而不是对所有输入都具备完整决策能力的程序 [ 8 , 22 ] 。因此，“未找到反例”仅意味着所配置的搜索未能发现另一个能重现相同漏洞的绕过方法。 第 4 节中独立的预留测试套件用于在修复结束后评估最终的补丁效果。

paragraphs.en: P2Patch targets known vulnerabilities in pinned C/C++ and Java project revisions. The attacker controls inputs relevant to the finding, such as archive entries, files, buffers, request parameters, serialized objects, command-line arguments, or network messages. We assume the revision can be built and exercised in its container and that the vulnerable effect is observable under the project contract. Regression checks are bounded behavioral oracles: passing them establishes compatibility only for the behaviors they exercise.
paragraphs.zh: P2Patch 针对已固定版本 C/C++ 和 Java 项目中已知的漏洞进行修复。 攻击者控制与发现相关输入，例如存档条目、文件、缓冲区、请求参数、序列化对象、命令行参数或网络消息。 我们假设该版本可以在其容器中构建并运行，且脆弱性影响在该项目合同中是可观察的。 回归测试是有限的行为预言机：通过测试仅能证明与它们所测试的行为兼容。

sents.zh: P2Patch 针对已固定版本 C/C++ 和 Java 项目中已知的漏洞进行修复。

paragraphs.en: The agents receive the normalized finding, source tree, and build metadata, but not the CVE identifier, upstream fix, advisory exploit text, or held-out suites, and web retrieval is disabled. These controls reduce direct leakage, but they do not remove knowledge acquired during pretraining. Each run uses a dedicated Git worktree and project container. The prototype does not claim host containment against a malicious repository. We treat the evaluation host and benchmark repositories as trusted infrastructure, and agent-produced edits, commands, and claims as untrusted inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体接收经过归一化的发现结果、源树和构建元数据，但不会获取 CVE 标识符、上游修复方案、建议性利用文本或预留测试套件，且网络检索功能已禁用。 这些控制措施减少了直接泄露，但并未消除预训练期间获得的知识。 每次运行都会使用一个专用的 Git 工作树和项目容器。 该原型并不声称能够抵御恶意仓库对主机的攻击。 我们将评估主机和基准测试仓库视为可信基础设施，而将智能体生成的编辑、命令和声明视为不可信输入。

paragraphs.en: The three-valued outcome avoids unsafe shortcuts. Bootstrap accepts a PoV only on Repro ; patch convergence accepts a transition only when all protected PoVs are Blocked and regression checks pass. Incon helps neither agent. Treating inconclusive execution as “blocked” would reward deleted harnesses, stale builds, and infrastructure failures. Treating it as “reproduced” would turn tool failures into false security findings. P2Patch therefore gives no security credit for inconclusive runs.
paragraphs.zh: 三值结果可避免不安全捷径。 Bootstrap 仅在 Repro 上接受 PoV；补丁收敛仅在所有受保护的 PoV 均为 Blocked 且回归检查通过时接受转换。 Incon 对两个智能体都没有帮助。 将无结论的执行视为“blocked”会奖励被删除的测试框架、过时的构建以及基础设施故障。 将其视为“reproduced”会将工具故障变成虚假的安全发现。 因此，P2Patch 不会对无结论的运行给予任何安全积分。

paragraphs.en: Regression checks are differential. A nonzero test result after patching counts against the patch only when a fresh comparison against the pristine revision supports that attribution. This matters because injected PoV files may be discovered by project test runners, projects may have flaky or environment-specific failures, and a stale build can fail for reasons unrelated to the proposed repair. The same execution semantics are used for live gates and final replay, while held-out evaluation suites are mounted only after repair terminates.
paragraphs.zh: 回归检查具有差异性。 补丁修复后出现非零测试结果，仅当与原始版本进行全新比较支持这种归因时，才将该结果计入该补丁的负面影响。 这一点很重要，因为注入的观点文件可能会被项目测试运行器发现，项目本身可能存在不稳定的或依赖特定环境的失败情况，而过时的构建也可能因与所提议修复无关的原因而失败。 实时门控和最终重播使用相同的执行语义，而预留的评估套件则仅在修复过程结束后才会启动。

paragraphs.en: The exploiter and patcher operate on the same changing program, but their permissions are asymmetric. The exploiter may create attack artifacts but must not weaken product code. The patcher may edit product code but must not delete, rewrite, or neuter protected PoVs. The orchestrator enforces this separation with two role-specific guards: before exploiter calls, it snapshots product sources and restores edits outside the PoV tree; before patcher calls, it snapshots the PoV tree and restores edits, deletions, additions, or symlink changes to protected PoVs.
paragraphs.zh: 利用者和修补者都在同一变化的程序上运行，但它们的权限是不对称的。 利用者可以创建攻击产物，但不得削弱产品代码。 修补者可以编辑产品代码，但不得删除、重写或中和受保护的 PoV。 协调者通过两种角色特定的守卫来强制执行这种分离：在利用者调用之前，它会快照产品源代码并恢复 PoV 树之外的编辑；在修补者调用之前，它会快照 PoV 树并恢复对受保护 PoV 的编辑、删除、添加或符号链接更改。

paragraphs.en: These guards are not a cosmetic implementation detail. Without them, the exploiter could manufacture an easy bypass by weakening the program, and the patcher could pass the gate by deleting or changing PoVs instead of fixing code. The guards make the requirement set meaningful: each PoV remains a protected executable requirement across patch revisions, and each patch is judged on product-code behavior rather than artifact tampering.
paragraphs.zh: 这些守卫并非一种表面化的实现细节。 没有它们，攻击者可以通过削弱程序来制造一个容易的绕过方法，而修补程序则可以通过删除或更改 PoV 而非修复代码来通过检查。 这些守卫使需求集具有实际意义：每个 PoV 在补丁修订中始终是一个受保护的执行需求，而每个补丁的判断依据是产品代码的行为，而非对程序实体的篡改。

paragraphs.en: The prototype is a Python orchestrator whose configurations are typed stage lists. Each stage declares required and produced artifacts, so configurations are dependency-checked before execution. Build metadata records project-specific toolchains and commands as ecosystem adapters rather than language-specific repair logic. Each run persists agent inputs and outputs, container logs, retry histories, diffs, and verdict files. The runner disables web retrieval and inherited agent settings so that experimental arms change repair evidence and loop structure, not the surrounding machinery. Full pseudocode and implementation details are in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 该原型是一个 Python 协调器，其配置为带类型标注的阶段列表。 每个阶段都会声明所需的产物和生成的产物，因此在执行前会对配置进行依赖检查。 构建元数据将项目特定的工具链和命令记录为生态系统适配器，而非特定语言的修复逻辑。 每次运行都会持久化智能体的输入与输出、容器日志、重试历史记录、差异对比以及判定文件。 运行器会禁用网络获取和继承的智能体设置，以确保实验分支改变的是修复证据和循环结构，而非外围机制。 完整的伪代码和实现细节见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: Tests used during repair are insufficient as independent evidence of patch correctness [ 67 ] . Similarly, live PoVs are necessary for construction but cannot independently measure final security because the patcher has seen them. P2Patch therefore scores every patch with two held-out oracle families whose certification rules are opposites, while keeping both separate from the requirement set that drives repair (Figure 3 ). Evidence used to construct the patch is never reused as the final measure of security coverage. This separation is the central methodological constraint in the paper: a patch may pass every live gate and still fail held-out paths that were not available during repair.
paragraphs.zh: 修复过程中使用的测试无法作为补丁正确性的独立证据 [ 67 ]。 同样，实时视角（PoVs）对于构建补丁是必要的，但它们无法独立衡量最终的安全性，因为补丁生成器已经见过这些视角。 因此，P2Patch 使用两个预留的“神谕”族系对每个补丁进行评分，这两个族系的认证规则相互对立，同时确保它们都与驱动修复的需求集保持分离（图 3）。 用于构建补丁的证据绝不会被重复用作安全覆盖的最终衡量标准。 这种分离是本文核心的方法论约束：一个补丁可能通过所有实时验证，但仍可能在修复时无法使用的预留路径上失败。

sents.zh: 修复过程中使用的测试无法作为补丁正确性的独立证据 [ 67 ]。

sents.en: This separation is the central methodological constraint in the paper: a patch may pass every live gate and still fail held-out paths that were not available during repair.
sents.zh: 这种分离是本文核心的方法论约束：一个补丁可能通过所有实时验证，但仍可能在修复时无法使用的预留路径上失败。

paragraphs.en: The held-out suites are manually authored outside the repair loop, finalized before scoring, and never shown to agents. They follow the same three-valued execution contract as live PoVs: a PoV can reproduce the vulnerability, be blocked by the program under test, or be inconclusive because execution does not establish either result. Inconclusive outcomes are excluded from the coverage denominator and provide no security credit. These checks establish behavior under the project execution contract; they are not complete semantic proofs.
paragraphs.zh: 预留的测试套件在修复循环之外由人工编写，在评分前最终确定，且绝不会展示给智能体。 它们遵循与实时观点（PoV）相同的三值执行协议：一个观点可以重现漏洞，也可能被受测程序阻止，或者由于执行无法确定任一结果而得出无结论的判定。 无结论的结果会被排除在覆盖率分母之外，且不会带来任何安全积分。 这些检查确立了项目执行协议下的行为；它们并非完整的语义证明。

paragraphs.en: A fix-closed PoV is a held-out PoV that reproduces on the buggy revision P vuln P_{\mathrm{vuln}} and is blocked by the officially patched revision P up P_{\mathrm{up}} :
paragraphs.zh: 一个固定闭合的 PoV 是一个保留下来的 PoV，它能在存在漏洞的修订版本 P vuln P_{\mathrm{vuln}} 上重现，并且会被已官方打补丁的修订版本 P up P_{\mathrm{up}} 阻止：

paragraphs.en: Fix-closed suites measure coverage of independently constructed attack paths that the recorded fix closes. They are not given to the exploiter as starting points and are not given to the patcher as tests. They are mounted only after a configuration ships a final patch. If a subject has five fix-closed PoVs and a generated patch blocks all five, then its fix-closed coverage for that subject is 100%; if it blocks only the path its live PoV drives, the held-out suite exposes that specialization.
paragraphs.zh: 已修复关闭套件衡量独立构建的攻击路径的覆盖范围，这些路径被记录在案的修复措施所关闭。 它们既不会作为起点提供给攻击者，也不会作为测试用例提供给补丁程序。 只有在配置发布最终补丁之后，它们才会被部署。 如果某个主体有五个已修复关闭的攻击视角（PoV），而生成的补丁阻止了全部五个，那么该主体针对此主体的已修复关闭覆盖率为100%；如果补丁仅阻止了其实际攻击视角所驱动的路径，那么预留的套件就会暴露这种专业化特性。

sents.en: Fix-closed suites measure coverage of independently constructed attack paths that the recorded fix closes.
sents.zh: 已修复关闭套件衡量独立构建的攻击路径的覆盖范围，这些路径被记录在案的修复措施所关闭。

paragraphs.en: This oracle type gives the official fix an operational role without treating it as source text to imitate. The generated patch is not compared syntactically with the upstream diff. It is evaluated behaviorally: does it block the same independently certified paths that the official fix blocks? This matters for LLM repair because two patches can look very different while providing similar coverage, and two superficially similar patches can differ on untested paths [ 64 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这种预言机类型赋予官方修复方案一个操作角色，但不会将其视为需要模仿的源文本。 生成的补丁不会与上游差异进行语法层面的比较。 它通过行为进行评估：它是否阻止了与官方修复方案相同的、经过独立认证的通路？ 这对 LLM 修复至关重要，因为两个补丁可能看起来截然不同，却提供了相似的覆盖范围；而两个表面相似的补丁，在未测试的通路上的表现也可能存在差异 [ 64 ]。

sents.en: This oracle type gives the official fix an operational role without treating it as source text to imitate.
sents.zh: 这种预言机类型赋予官方修复方案一个操作角色，但不会将其视为需要模仿的源文本。

sents.zh: 生成的补丁不会与上游差异进行语法层面的比较。

paragraphs.en: A residual PoV is a held-out PoV that reproduces on both the buggy revision and the official fixed revision:
paragraphs.zh: 残差视角是一种保留下来的视角，它既能在有错误的修订版本中重现，也能在官方修复后的修订版本中重现：

paragraphs.en: Residual suites measure candidate gaps that appear to survive the recorded fix. Because the official fix does not block them, they are certified by an inverted rule rather than the fix-closed one. We therefore treat them as manually curated candidate gaps in the official patch, and report them separately as C res C_{\mathrm{res}} . Later upstream commits that close the same behavior provide additional evidence that a residual path was security-relevant, but they are not required for inclusion.
paragraphs.zh: 残余漏洞集合衡量那些在已记录修复之后似乎仍然存在候选漏洞。 由于官方修复并未阻止它们，因此它们是通过反向规则而非“修复已关闭”规则来认证的。 因此，我们将它们视为官方补丁中经人工筛选的候选漏洞，并单独报告为 C res C_{\mathrm{res}}。 后续上游提交中关闭相同行为的代码提供了额外证据，表明某条残余路径具有安全相关性，但这些提交并非纳入该集合的必要条件。

sents.en: Residual suites measure candidate gaps that appear to survive the recorded fix.
sents.zh: 残余漏洞集合衡量那些在已记录修复之后似乎仍然存在候选漏洞。

sents.en: Because the official fix does not block them, they are certified by an inverted rule rather than the fix-closed one.
sents.zh: 由于官方修复并未阻止它们，因此它们是通过反向规则而非“修复已关闭”规则来认证的。

sents.en: We therefore treat them as manually curated candidate gaps in the official patch, and report them separately as C res C_{\mathrm{res}} .
sents.zh: 因此，我们将它们视为官方补丁中经人工筛选的候选漏洞，并单独报告为 C res C_{\mathrm{res}}。

sents.en: Later upstream commits that close the same behavior provide additional evidence that a residual path was security-relevant, but they are not required for inclusion.
sents.zh: 后续上游提交中关闭相同行为的代码提供了额外证据，表明某条残余路径具有安全相关性，但这些提交并非纳入该集合的必要条件。

paragraphs.en: Reporting fix-closed and residual suites separately avoids overclaiming. A patch can match official-patch behavior by covering fix-closed paths while still leaving nearby behaviors open; conversely, a patch that blocks residual paths may be stronger than the recorded fix on those paths.

paragraphs.en: For both oracle types, coverage is computed only over conclusive executions. paragraphs.en: Oracle leakage is controlled by separation in time and interface. The claim is narrower and operational: the repair loop cannot inspect or execute the evaluation suites that determine the reported coverage.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on VulnRepairBench , the benchmark we assemble for this work (Appendix D ). A subject is a project–CVE instance at a pinned vulnerable revision, with a source tree, normalized finding, container definition, and project-specific build, PoV-execution, and regression commands [ 24 ] . C/C++ subjects are derived from VulnLoc+ [ 68 , 50 ] , restricted to those whose required contracts could be reproduced. Java subjects are curated from GitHub Security Advisories and the NVD; each uses a manually checked CodeQL-derived taint finding consistent with the advisory and vulnerable revision [ 2 , 5 ] . The leakage controls of Section 4.3 apply to every subject and configuration. VulnRepairBench contains 101 CVEs (60 Java and 41 C/C++) over 61 distinct repositories (51 Java and 10 C/C++), and spans 20 weakness classes with no overlap between the two ecosystems. Every CVE has a certified fix-closed suite with 1–14 PoVs; residual suites exist only where the official fix leaves a demonstrated gap, with 1–5 PoVs each. Table 1 summarizes these totals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 VulnRepairBench 上进行评估，这是我们为这项工作构建的基准（附录 D）。 一个测试用例是一个项目–CVE 实例，位于某个固定的脆弱版本中，包含源代码树、规范化的漏洞发现结果、容器定义，以及特定于项目的构建、PoV 执行和回归测试命令 [24]。 C/C++ 测试用例源自 VulnLoc+ [68, 50]，仅限于那些所需契约能够被复现的项目。 Java 测试用例从 GitHub 安全建议和 NVD 中精选；每个用例都使用经过人工验证的、源自 CodeQL 且与安全和脆弱版本一致的污染检测结果 [2, 5]。 第 4.3 节中的泄漏控制适用于所有测试用例和配置。 VulnRepairBench 包含 101 个 CVE（60 个 Java 和 41 个 C/C++），分布在 61 个不同的仓库中（51 个 Java 和 10 个 C/C++），涵盖 20 类弱点，且两个生态系统之间没有重叠。 每个 CVE 都有一个经过认证的修复关闭套件，包含 1–14 个 PoV；仅当官方修复存在已证实的漏洞时，才会存在残留套件，每个残留套件包含 1–5 个 PoV。 表 1 总结了这些总数。

paragraphs.en: All agents run through the same harness: Claude Code (v2.1.241), a coding agent with file, shell, and search tools. Every invocation is restricted to a per-run Git worktree, with web retrieval and orchestration tools disabled, no inherited settings, a pinned model, and a pre-execution command hook. This includes P2Patch itself, so the arms differ only in the evidence and loop structure the orchestrator imposes on that harness, not in the agent driving it. Configurations receive identical inputs apart from the experimental variable, use the same applicable per-stage budgets, and are scored by identical held-out suites. The main comparison gives the exploiter three attempts when an exploitation stage is present, each convergence gate three evaluations (hence at most two corrective patches), and the hardening loop four rounds. Deviations from these budgets that never became binding are reported with the results.
paragraphs.zh: 所有智能体都运行于相同的框架：Claude Code（v2.1.241），这是一个具备文件、外壳和搜索工具的编码智能体。 每次调用都被限制在每次运行专用的 Git 工作树中，同时禁用网络检索和协调工具，不继承任何设置，使用固定模型，并执行预执行命令钩子。 这包括 P2Patch 本身，因此各方的区别仅在于协调器在该框架上施加的证据和循环结构，而非驱动该框架的智能体。 除了实验变量外，各配置接收相同的输入，使用相同的各阶段适用预算，并由相同的预留测试套件进行评分。 主要比较中，当存在利用阶段时，利用者可获得三次尝试，每次收敛门限包含三次评估（因此最多两次修正补丁），而加固循环则包含四轮。 结果报告中会说明那些从未成为约束的、对这些预算的偏离情况。

paragraphs.en: Manual review is performed only after a candidate patch passes the automated execution and regression gates. Two reviewers independently assess each candidate using a fixed rubric covering unintended functional changes, removal or weakening of security-relevant logic, build-system modifications, deletion or circumvention of tests or harnesses, and introduction of new security risks. Reviewers are blinded to the model and experimental configuration and base their decisions only on the patch diff, relevant program context, and execution evidence. Disagreements are resolved through joint adjudication. The same procedure is applied across all configurations. Held-out security oracles are not available during this review and do not influence patch acceptance.
paragraphs.zh: 只有在候选补丁通过自动化执行和回归测试关卡后，才会进行人工审查。 两名审查员独立使用固定评分标准对每个候选补丁进行评估，该标准涵盖非预期的功能变更、与安全相关逻辑的移除或削弱、构建系统的修改、测试或测试框架的删除或规避，以及新安全风险的引入。 审查员对模型和实验配置不知情，其决策仅基于补丁差异、相关程序上下文和执行证据。 意见分歧通过联合裁决解决。 所有配置均适用相同的流程。 在此审查过程中，预留的安全判据不可用，且不会影响补丁的接受。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether adversarial hardening exposes bypasses that one-shot repair misses, whether those bypasses translate into higher held-out security coverage, and whether the effect generalizes across models and published repair systems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了以下问题：对抗性加固是否会暴露单次修复未能发现的绕过方法；这些绕过方法是否意味着更高的保留集安全覆盖范围；以及这种效果是否在不同模型和已发布的修复系统中具有普适性。

paragraphs.en: We ask five questions. RQ1 tests whether accepted repairs can still be bypassed after blocking their construction PoV. RQ2 measures held-out coverage and cost relative to single-pass repair from the same finding. RQ3 attributes the gains to the bootstrap PoV and adversarial hardening loop. RQ4 tests model dependence. RQ5 compares published baselines under the same independent security oracles.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了五个问题。 RQ1 检验在阻止其构建 PoV 后，已接受的修复是否仍能被绕过。 RQ2 衡量与来自同一发现的单次修复相比，保留覆盖范围和成本的情况。 RQ3 将这些增益归因于自举 PoV 和对抗性加固循环。 RQ4 检验模型依赖性。 RQ5 在相同的独立安全预言机下比较已发表的基线方法。

paragraphs.en: If blocking the PoV that triggered a patch were sufficient evidence of repair, an attacker targeting that patched program would find no further same-vulnerability path. We test this directly by turning the exploitation agent against the patch produced from its own bootstrap PoV.

paragraphs.en: Two runs in five expose a bypass after the patch has passed its own gate. In 41 of 101 runs (41%), the exploiter produced a distinct, execution-confirmed bypass of a patch that had already blocked the PoV it was built from. Across those runs, the exploiter found 68 bypasses in total. Ninety-nine runs reached the adversarial phase, so the rate over attackable runs is also 41%. The per-run distribution is 60 runs with no bypass, 26 with one, 7 with two, 4 with three, and 4 with four. A system that stopped after the first blocked PoV would have accepted all 41 bypassed patches without any signal that the repair remained incomplete.
paragraphs.zh: 五次运行中的两次在补丁通过自身关卡后暴露出绕过漏洞。 在 101 次运行中的 41 次（41%）中，攻击者成功产生了一个明确且经执行验证的绕过漏洞，而该补丁此前已经阻止了生成该漏洞的 PoV。 在这些运行中，攻击者总共发现了 68 个绕过漏洞。 99 次运行进入了对抗阶段，因此可攻击运行中的这一比率也为 41%。 每次运行的分布情况为：60 次没有绕过漏洞，26 次有一个，7 次有两个，4 次有三个，4 次有四个。 一个在第一个 PoV 被阻止后就停止的系统，将会接受所有 41 个被绕过的补丁，而没有任何迹象表明修复仍未完成。

paragraphs.en: The bypass rate does not decay with depth. paragraphs.en: The orchestrator enforces execution, not semantic novelty. A candidate bypass counts only if execution reproduces the vulnerable behavior against the current patch. The new bypass and e 0 e_{0} are protected by the per-round gate; earlier bypasses are replayed by the post-hardening gate described in Section 3.4 . The orchestrator rejects candidates that merely replay a previous PoV command. However, we prompt for semantic distinctness beyond that—whether a candidate uses a genuinely different sink rather than a re-encoding of the same path, for example—but do not machine-check it. The 41% rate is therefore an upper bound on semantically distinct bypasses. The key result is still execution-grounded: patches that had passed their own construction-time checks often remained vulnerable to additional same-vulnerability PoVs.
paragraphs.zh: 协调器强制执行操作，而非追求语义上的新颖性。 只有当执行过程在当前补丁下重现了漏洞行为时，候选绕过方案才算有效。 新的绕过方案和 e 0 e_{0} 受到每轮门控的保护；而早期的绕过方案则由第 3.4 节中描述的加固后门控重新执行。 协调器会拒绝那些仅重复先前 PoV 命令的候选方案。 然而，我们要求超越这一点的语义差异性——例如，候选方案是否使用了真正不同的目标，而非对相同路径的重新编码——但我们不会通过机器验证这一点。 因此，41% 的比例是语义上具有差异性的绕过方案的一个上限。 关键结果仍然基于执行层面：那些在构建时通过了自身检查的补丁，往往仍对针对同一漏洞的其他 PoV 存在脆弱性。

sents.en: The key result is still execution-grounded: patches that had passed their own construction-time checks often remained vulnerable to additional same-vulnerability PoVs.

paragraphs.en: P2Patch produces accepted repairs on 98 of 101 subjects. A patch is accepted only after it builds, blocks every live PoV in the requirement set, passes differential regression checks, and survives the standardized manual-review protocol of Section 5 . The third failure is a patch rejected by manual review. No run was lost at a post-patch execution gate: failed gates returned to the responsible agent, and the correction loop converged within the configured budget for every run that entered repair.

paragraphs.en: The certified suites do not depend on P2Patch , so they can also score patches produced by other repair systems. We compare P2Patch with SinglePass on the full benchmark, and with San2Patch , LoopRepair, and PatchAgent on pairwise shared subjects. Within each comparison, both systems are scored on the same CVEs, under the same oracle suites and the same intention-to-treat policy used everywhere else in this section. A system that reported no patch, or whose own pipeline rejected one, is credited zero on that subject rather than dropped. These comparisons are still not a global ranking: the subject set, input representation, and available artifacts differ by system.
paragraphs.zh: 经过认证的套件不依赖 P2Patch，因此它们也可以对由其他修复系统生成的补丁进行评分。 我们在完整基准测试上比较了 P2Patch 与 SinglePass，并在成对共享的主题上比较了它与 San2Patch、LoopRepair 和 PatchAgent。 在每次比较中，两个系统都基于相同的 CVE、相同的 oracle 套件以及本节的其余部分所采用的相同意向治疗策略进行评分。 对于未报告任何补丁或自身流程拒绝了补丁的系统，在该主题上计为零分，而非跳过不计。 这些比较仍然不构成全局排名：不同系统的主题集、输入表示和可用工件均有所不同。

paragraphs.en: P2Patch does not prove that a generated patch is complete. The exploiter is a budgeted agent, the live PoV set is finite, and the held-out suites contain human-authored attack paths rather than the full input space. A stable run therefore means only that the configured exploiter failed to find another execution-confirmed same-vulnerability bypass and that the final patch covered the certified suites to the reported degree [ 30 ] . This is stronger than reusing the construction PoV as the sole validation oracle, but it remains a testing claim rather than a formal proof [ 32 ] .
paragraphs.zh: P2Patch 并未证明所生成的补丁是完整的。 攻击者是一个预算受限的智能体，实际使用的 PoV 集合是有限的，而预留的测试套件包含由人类编写的攻击路径，而非完整的输入空间。 因此，一次稳定的运行仅意味着：配置的攻击者未能找到另一个已证实可执行的相同漏洞绕过方法，且最终补丁对已认证的测试套件的覆盖程度达到了报告的水平 [ 30 ] 。 这比仅重复使用构建 PoV 作为唯一的验证机制更具说服力，但它仍然是一项测试性主张，而非形式化证明 [ 32 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Oracle certification is execution-based: a PoV enters a suite only by reproducing on the recorded vulnerable tree and then satisfying the fix-closed or residual certification rule. Because all configurations are scored by identical held-out suites, oracle curation does not differentially favor one arm within a paired comparison. The remaining risk is coverage bias: the suites contain human-authored paths, not all relevant paths. Residual PoVs require particular care. They demonstrate same-vulnerability paths that survive the official fix, but the official fix itself does not certify them as fixed. Later upstream fixes corroborate 14 residual gaps (Appendix G ); for 8 of them we confirmed by execution that the PoV is blocked on the later tree, and extending that to every row remains future work.
paragraphs.zh: Oracle 认证基于执行：一个 PoV 仅通过在已记录的脆弱树上重现，然后满足修复关闭或残留认证规则，才能进入测试套件。 由于所有配置都通过相同的预留测试套件进行评分，因此 Oracle 的筛选不会在成对比较中偏向某一分支。 剩余的风险是覆盖偏差：这些测试套件包含人类编写的路径，但并非所有相关路径。 残留的 PoV 需要特别关注。 它们展示了在官方修复后仍然存在相同漏洞的路径，但官方修复本身并未认证这些路径为已修复。 后续的上游修复证实了 14 个残留缺口（附录 G）；其中 8 个缺口，我们通过执行确认了 PoV 在后续树上被阻断，而将这一结论扩展到每一行仍是未来的工作。

paragraphs.en: The published-system comparison is an end-to-end oracle comparison, not a claim that prior systems failed under their original criteria. Section 6.5 scores available patches on shared subjects using the same certified suites, which measures held-out attack-path coverage that the original validations may not have tested. The comparison therefore reflects differences in input modality, repair protocol, repair budget, implementation maturity, and validation policy, not only the adversarial loop. Its purpose is to show that independent security oracles expose gaps missed by conventional validation, not to produce a universal ranking of repair systems.
paragraphs.zh: 已发布系统的对比是一种端到端的“神谕”式对比，而非声称先前系统在原有标准下表现不佳。 第 6.5 节使用相同的认证套件对可用补丁在共享主题上的表现进行评分，从而衡量了原始验证可能未测试到的保留攻击路径的覆盖范围。 因此，这种对比反映了输入模态、修复协议、修复预算、实现成熟度和验证策略等方面的差异，而不仅仅是对抗循环的差异。 其目的是展示独立的安全“神谕”能够揭示传统验证所遗漏的漏洞，而非对修复系统生成一个普适性的排名。

It is less able to explain paired differences between configurations that use the same model and differ only in the repair-time evidence constructed during the run. It remains, however, a limitation of evaluating LLM-based repair on public vulnerabilities. Redacting CVE identifiers, upstream patches, advisory exploit text, and held-out PoVs reduces direct leakage through the prompt, but cannot remove knowledge already encoded in the model [ 38 ] .

paragraphs.en: Automated vulnerability repair spans learning-based, analysis-based, and LLM-based systems [ 20 ] . Recent systematizations organize the area around localization, patch generation, and validation, and identify correctness assessment as a persistent bottleneck [ 21 , 36 ] . Learning-based approaches often translate vulnerable code into fixed code under an assumed edit location [ 68 , 10 , 23 , 62 ] . Analysis-based systems such as ExtractFix and VulnFix derive repair constraints from concrete failures or vulnerability witnesses [ 13 , 74 , 40 , 43 ] . Recent agentic systems, including Appatch , PatchAgent , San2Patch , CodeCureAgent , the OSS-Fuzz repair agent, and LoopRepair, use LLMs with vulnerable code, warnings, traces, or reproduction artifacts and iterate on compiler, test, sanitizer, or reviewer feedback [ 45 , 71 , 29 , 26 , 76 , 68 , 73 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 自动化漏洞修复涵盖了基于学习、基于分析和基于大型语言模型的系统 [ 20 ] 。 近期的系统综述将这一领域划分为定位、补丁生成和验证三个部分，并指出正确性评估是一个长期存在的瓶颈 [ 21 , 36 ] 。 基于学习的方法通常会在假设的编辑位置下，将存在漏洞的代码转换为修复后的代码 [ 68 , 10 , 23 , 62 ] 。 基于分析的系统（如 ExtractFix 和 VulnFix）会从具体的故障或漏洞证据中推导出修复约束 [ 13 , 74 , 40 , 43 ] 。 近期的智能体系统（包括 Appatch、PatchAgent、San2Patch、CodeCureAgent、OSS-Fuzz 修复智能体和 LoopRepair）会结合存在漏洞的代码、警告信息、追踪记录或复现产物，并利用大型语言模型，同时根据编译器、测试工具、净化器或评审员的反馈进行迭代优化 [ 45 , 71 , 29 , 26 , 76 , 68 , 73 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Most recent systems iterate, but the iteration usually searches for a patch against a fixed target: a warning, crash, sanitizer trace, supplied PoV, or reviewer failure [ 75 ] . San2Patch explores reasoning paths, PatchAgent iterates over tool actions and rejected patches, LoopRepair ranks candidate patches using taint-trace feedback, and CodeCureAgent iterates through tool calls and approver feedback [ 29 , 71 , 68 , 26 ] . P2Patch changes a different object: the repair objective. Once a patch blocks the current PoVs, the patched program becomes the next attack target, and each execution-confirmed same-vulnerability bypass becomes a new repair requirement. This resembles counterexample-guided synthesis [ 54 , 11 ] , but uses a budgeted exploiter rather than a complete verifier.

paragraphs.en: A complementary line of work generates proof-of-vulnerability artifacts rather than patches [ 4 , 9 ] . SemFuzz generates Linux-kernel exploits from vulnerability text and code semantics [ 70 ] ; FaultLine generates language-agnostic PoV tests [ 44 ] ; PoC-Gym studies static-trace guidance for Java PoVs [ 14 ] ; and CVE-Genie reconstructs environments and verifiable exploits from public CVE material [ 56 ] . P2Patch uses that capability as a repair primitive: the first PoV bootstraps repair, while later PoVs test whether the current patch can be bypassed.

paragraphs.en: Patch validation is a long-standing weakness of automated repair [ 16 , 42 , 57 ] . Test-suite overfitting can produce plausible patches that pass available tests but miss the intended repair [ 52 , 47 ] , and generated tests can expose such patches [ 66 , 63 ] . Security repair inherits this problem: blocking one PoV, sanitizer trace, or functional test does not imply that the security boundary is enforced. PVBench shows that PoV-plus-functional-test validation can overestimate vulnerability-repair success [ 72 ] , while VulnRepairEval and PatchEval move toward executable, containerized security tests for LLM patch assessment [ 58 , 60 ] . P2Patch adopts executable validation but separates construction-time PoVs from held-out evaluation suites.
paragraphs.zh: 补丁验证是自动化修复长期存在的弱点 [ 16 , 42 , 57 ] 。 测试套件过拟合可能会生成看似合理的补丁，这些补丁能通过现有测试，却未能实现预期的修复效果 [ 52 , 47 ] ，而生成的测试则能够暴露此类问题 [ 66 , 63 ] 。 安全修复也存在这一问题：阻止某个攻击视角（PoV）、消毒程序追踪或功能测试，并不意味着安全边界得到了有效执行。 PVBench 表明，结合攻击视角与功能测试的验证方式可能会高估漏洞修复的成功率 [ 72 ] ，而 VulnRepairEval 和 PatchEval 则正朝着可执行、容器化的安全测试方向演进，用于评估 LLM 生成的补丁 [ 58 , 60 ] 。 P2Patch 采用了可执行的验证方法，但将构建阶段的攻击视角与预留的评估套件进行了分离。

paragraphs.en: Many repair evaluations use the developer or official fix as the target behavior, through syntactic matching, supplied tests, or paths known to be closed by the recorded fix [ 13 , 74 , 72 , 60 , 6 , 7 , 41 ] . This is useful, but it can make the official fix a ceiling: paths the official fix leaves open are not measured. Prior work shows that security patches can be incomplete or require later correction [ 34 , 17 , 39 , 46 ] , and that vulnerable code propagates across projects through reuse [ 49 ] . P2Patch therefore reports fix-closed PoVs, which are blocked by the official fix, separately from residual PoVs, which remain reproducible after the official fix and measure beyond-upstream hardening.
paragraphs.zh: 许多修复评估都将开发者或官方的修复方案作为目标行为，通过语法匹配、提供的测试用例或已知被记录修复方案关闭的路径来实现 [ 13 , 74 , 72 , 60 , 6 , 7 , 41 ] 。 这种方法虽然有用，但可能会使官方修复方案成为一个上限：官方修复方案未关闭的路径不会被纳入衡量范围。 先前的研究指出，安全补丁可能不完整或需要后续修正 [ 34 , 17 , 39 , 46 ] ，并且存在漏洞的代码会通过代码重用在不同项目间传播 [ 49 ] 。 因此，P2Patch 会分别报告被官方修复方案阻断的“修复已关闭视角”（fix-closed PoVs），以及官方修复方案之后仍存在可重现性的“剩余视角”（residual PoVs），后者用于衡量超越上游代码的加固效果。

paragraphs.en: This paper presented P2Patch , an exploit-guided vulnerability-repair protocol that treats each accepted patch as a new attack target. Rather than validating a repair only against the evidence that produced it, P2Patch grows the repair objective whenever execution confirms a new same-vulnerability bypass and evaluates the final patch with independent held-out security oracles. Across 101 C/C++ and Java CVE subjects, the exploiter bypassed already-accepted patches in 41% of runs. Relative to single-pass repair from the same finding, P2Patch increased held-out fix-closed coverage from 0.781 to 0.847 and residual coverage from 0.421 to 0.625. Re-scoring published repair systems under the same certified oracles further showed that patches accepted by their original validation can leave attack paths unblocked. These results suggest that adaptive counterexample growth and independent evaluation provide a stronger basis for assessing automated vulnerability repair, while remaining a bounded testing methodology rather than a proof of patch completeness.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 P2Patch，这是一种以漏洞利用为引导的漏洞修复协议，它将每个已接受的补丁视为一个新的攻击目标。 P2Patch 并非仅根据生成修复的证据来验证修复效果，而是每当执行过程确认存在针对同一漏洞的新绕过方式时，就会扩展修复目标，并通过独立的预留安全预言机对最终补丁进行评估。 在 101 个 C/C++ 和 Java 的 CVE 样本中，攻击者在 41% 的运行中成功绕过了已接受的补丁。 与基于相同发现的一次性修复相比，P2Patch 将预留修复覆盖范围从 0.781 提升至 0.847，并将剩余覆盖范围从 0.421 提升至 0.625。 在相同的认证预言机下对已发布的修复系统重新评分进一步表明，其原始验证所接受的补丁可能仍会留下未阻断的攻击路径。 这些结果表明，自适应的反例扩展和独立评估为评估自动化漏洞修复提供了更坚实的基础，但本质上仍是一种有界的测试方法，而非补丁完整性的证明。

paragraphs.en: This work studies automated repair for already reported vulnerabilities, but it has dual-use risk. The same mechanism that tests whether a patch is incomplete can generate executable proof-of-vulnerability artifacts. We therefore designed the evaluation to reduce harm while preserving scientific auditability. All experiments run on pinned historical revisions inside project containers or per-run worktrees. Agents do not scan live services, interact with third-party deployments, or retrieve web content during repair. Their inputs exclude CVE identifiers, upstream patches, advisory exploit text, and held-out evaluation PoVs, and all generated commands, edits, and model outputs are treated as untrusted artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作研究了已报告漏洞的自动化修复，但存在双重用途风险。 用于检测补丁是否不完整的同一机制，也可能生成可执行的漏洞证明产物。 因此，我们在设计评估方案时，力求在保持科学可审计性的同时减少潜在危害。 所有实验均在项目容器或每次运行的工作树内，基于已固定的历史版本执行。 智能体在修复过程中不会扫描实时服务、与第三方部署交互或检索网络内容。 其输入排除了CVE标识符、上游补丁、建议性利用文本以及预留的评估视角，且所有生成的命令、编辑和模型输出均被视为不可信的产物。

paragraphs.en: The most sensitive cases are residual PoVs: PoVs that reproduce both before and after the recorded official fix. Such artifacts can indicate that a released fix left a same-vulnerability path open, and in some cases our upstream-history analysis found that maintainers later closed the same behavior. We therefore do not treat residual PoVs as ordinary benchmark tests. For residual paths that remain open in maintained projects, we follow coordinated disclosure and withhold the executable artifacts (payload, harness, and command) until the affected project ships a fix; public materials describe only the weakness class, certification rule, and aggregate outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 最敏感的情况是残留视角（PoVs）：即在官方修复记录前后均能重现的视角。 此类异常现象可能表明已发布的修复方案仍保留了相同漏洞的路径，在某些情况下，我们的上游历史分析发现维护者后来关闭了相同的行为。 因此，我们不将残留视角视为普通的基准测试。 对于在持续维护项目中仍然开放的残留路径，我们遵循协调披露原则，在受影响的项目发布修复方案之前，不公开可执行的艺术品（有效载荷、测试框架和命令）；公开材料仅描述漏洞类型、认证规则和汇总结果。

paragraphs.en: Responsible disclosure and reporting. We have reported all 9 gaps that remain open at upstream’s current head (Appendix G ) to the 8 affected projects, each through its stated security channel: the ASF security team for the Apache subjects, a private GitHub advisory or a vendor security address otherwise. Each report carries the minimum needed to triage: affected component and revision, weakness class, certification rule, and a summary of the surviving path; full reproduction details are available to each project on request. Two of the repositories have been dormant for more than two years, so those notifications are best-effort.

paragraphs.en: Our claims are bounded accordingly. P2Patch is a repair-evaluation method, not a tool for attacking deployed systems. paragraphs.en: This appendix gives the stage-level protocol used by the orchestrator. paragraphs.zh: 本附录介绍了协调器使用的舞台级协议。 主论文描述了设计不变量；算法 1 记录了评估中使用的确切控制流，包括启动尝试、补丁收敛尝试、对抗性加固轮次以及加固后的重演。

sents.en: The main paper describes the design invariants; Algorithm 1 records the exact control flow used in the evaluation, including bootstrap attempts, patch-convergence attempts, adversarial hardening rounds, and post-hardening replay.
sents.zh: 主论文描述了设计不变量；算法 1 记录了评估中使用的确切控制流，包括启动尝试、补丁收敛尝试、对抗性加固轮次以及加固后的重演。

paragraphs.en: A run returns a patch only if all construction-time gates succeed. Any bootstrap failure, exhausted correction budget, failed post-hardening replay, or inconclusive protected PoV produces a rejected repair, which receives no coverage credit under the intention-to-treat policy. The evaluation uses κ att = 3 \kappa_{\mathrm{att}}{=}3 attacker attempts, κ gate = 3 \kappa_{\mathrm{gate}}{=}3 gate evaluations per convergence call, and R = 4 R{=}4 adversarial rounds unless otherwise stated.
paragraphs.zh: 仅当所有构建时段的门控操作均成功时，一次运行才会返回一个补丁。 任何引导失败、校正预算耗尽、硬化后重演失败，或受保护的观点（PoV）结果不明确，都会导致修复被拒绝；根据“意向治疗”政策，此类修复不会获得任何覆盖信用。 除非另有说明，评估将采用 κ att = 3 \kappa_{\mathrm{att}}{=}3 次攻击尝试、κ gate = 3 \kappa_{\mathrm{gate}}{=}3 次门控评估（每次收敛调用），以及 R = 4 R{=}4 轮对抗性回合。

paragraphs.en: Subject construction. paragraphs.en: Oracle construction. Held-out PoVs are authored outside the repair loop and finalized before scoring. paragraphs.en: The main text reports aggregate pairwise comparisons against SinglePass , San2Patch , LoopRepair, and PatchAgent . This subsection makes the published-system comparison auditable at the case level. For each of the 41 C/C++ subjects, Table 10 reports whether each system blocks all, some, or none of the certified paths in each oracle family, C fix C_{\mathrm{fix}} and C res C_{\mathrm{res}} . The table uses the same symbolic grammar throughout: ✓ \checkmark denotes full blocking, △ \triangle denotes partial blocking, × \times denotes no blocking, ∅ \varnothing denotes no reported patch, — denotes no applicable certified suite or a subject outside that system’s benchmark, and ? denotes a subject that was not measured. Its subject set is the paper’s, so an unrepaired subject is a ∅ \varnothing row rather than an absent one — including the two P2Patch itself left unrepaired — and its “blocks every certified path” totals are the same counts that Table 5 averages.

paragraphs.en: Table 10 should be read as a shared-oracle re-scoring, not as a reproduction of each paper’s original evaluation. Prior systems used different inputs and validation criteria: some were driven by crashing inputs or sanitizer traces, while our main configuration starts from a normalized finding and grows repair requirements through execution-confirmed bypasses. We therefore score available patches or rerun artifacts under the same held-out suites to measure what their original validation may not have tested.
paragraphs.zh: 表 10 应被理解为共享预言机重新评分，而非每篇论文原始评估的复现。 早期系统使用了不同的输入和验证标准：有些系统由崩溃性输入或消毒程序追踪驱动，而我们的主要配置则从一个归一化的发现开始，通过执行确认的绕过机制逐步扩展修复需求。 因此，我们在相同的预留测试套件下对可用的补丁或重运行产物进行评分，以衡量其原始验证可能未覆盖的内容。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 provides the corresponding cost–coverage diagnostic on the same shared C/C++ benchmark. It uses a strict coverage reading: the fraction of subjects whose patch blocks every certified fix-closed path, counting a subject the system left unrepaired against it. This view separates two questions that are otherwise easy to conflate: whether a method can ship a patch cheaply, and whether that patch covers all certified paths under the independent oracle suite.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 提供了在同一共享 C/C++ 基准测试上对应的成本–覆盖诊断结果。 它采用严格的覆盖度判定标准：即那些补丁能够阻断所有经认证的已闭合修复路径的样本所占比例，其中系统未修复的样本也会被计入统计。 这种视角区分了两个原本容易混淆的问题：一种方法能否以低成本发布补丁，以及该补丁是否覆盖了在独立预言机套件下所有经认证的路径。

paragraphs.en: The cost view is diagnostic rather than primary. Our main claim is not that counterexample-guided repair is cheaper than one-shot repair; the protocol runs additional exploitation and correction stages by design. Instead, Figure 5 shows the coverage obtained for that extra work under a common oracle. The comparison is therefore end-to-end: it reflects differences in input modality, repair protocol, implementation maturity, and validation policy, not only the adversarial hardening loop.
paragraphs.zh: 成本视角更多是诊断性的，而非首要的。 我们的主要论点并非“以反例为指导的修复比一次性修复更便宜”；该协议的设计本身就会运行额外的利用和修正阶段。 相反，图 5 展示了在常见预言机下，这些额外工作所获得的覆盖范围。 因此，这种比较是端到端的：它反映了输入模式、修复协议、实现成熟度和验证策略方面的差异，而不仅仅是对抗性加固循环的差异。

paragraphs.en: Table 11 summarizes the conceptual distinction between P2Patch and recent iterative repair systems. The key question is not whether a system iterates—all recent agentic systems do—but what the loop ranges over and whether the target can change after a patch is accepted. Prior systems iterate over reasoning paths, agent actions, candidate patches, or failed patches while the success target remains fixed. P2Patch instead changes the repair objective: each execution-confirmed bypass of the current patch becomes a new repair requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 表 11 总结了 P2Patch 与近期迭代修复系统之间的概念性区别。 关键问题不在于某个系统是否进行迭代——所有近期的智能体系统都会迭代——而在于循环覆盖的范围，以及补丁被接受后目标是否可以改变。 早期的系统在推理路径、智能体动作、候选补丁或失败补丁之间进行迭代，而成功目标始终保持不变。 P2Patch 则改变了修复目标：每次经执行确认的当前补丁绕过都会成为一项新的修复要求。

paragraphs.en: This distinction also explains why the empirical and conceptual comparisons are both needed. The empirical re-scoring asks how prior patches behave under our held-out certified oracles. The conceptual comparison explains why P2Patch may produce different patches in the first place: the target is not fixed to the initial alert, trace, crash, or PoV, but can expand whenever the current patch is execution-falsified.

paragraphs.en: A residual PoV certifies that a path remains exploitable after the official fix, which makes it a valid measuring instrument but does not by itself establish that the gap mattered. We therefore manually reviewed every certified residual gap against upstream’s current code and history. Figure 6 plots the outcome, restricted to the gaps whose disposition we could settle with confidence and whose claim falls inside the CVE’s own scope — 37 PoVs over 23 gaps in 19 projects; gaps that no released tree ever carried, and those we could not settle, are left out.
paragraphs.zh: 一项残留的 PoV 证明，在官方修复之后，某条路径仍然可以被利用；这使得它成为一个有效的测量工具，但本身并不能说明该漏洞确实重要。 因此，我们手动审查了每一项经认证的残留漏洞，并将其与上游当前的代码和历史记录进行了比对。 图 6 展示了这一结果，但仅限于那些我们能够自信确定其状态且其主张属于 CVE 自身范围的漏洞——共涉及 19 个项目中的 23 个漏洞和 37 项 PoV；从未被任何已发布版本包含的漏洞以及我们无法确定状态的漏洞均未纳入其中。

sents.zh: 还有一个案例更进一步：plexus-utils 漏洞被独立地重新发现，并被分配了 CVE-2025-67030，而修复该漏洞的提交是在九年半之后才完成的。

paragraphs.en: The remaining 9 gaps — 12 PoVs — are still present at upstream’s head, between a year and a half and ten years after the fix meant to close them, one in a maintained and widely deployed dependency-scanning tool. All 9 have been reported to their projects (Section A ).
paragraphs.zh: 其余的 9 个漏洞——12 个视角——在修复旨在关闭它们的一年半到十年后，仍然存在于上游的源头中，其中一个出现在一个经过维护且广泛部署的依赖扫描工具中。 这 9 个漏洞均已报告给其所属项目（A 节）。

paragraphs.en: Two caveats apply. Open at head is not the same as exploitable: several of these gaps drive a library API or command-line tool rather than a product entry point, and reachability from attacker-controlled input must be established case by case before any one is a finding. And intervals are measured commit to commit, not as a user experiences them; release-to-release exposure can differ sharply, as the antisamy row shows, where 13 days between commits still let two releases ship carrying the gap.
paragraphs.zh: 有两点需要注意。 “开放于头部”并不等同于“可被利用”：这些漏洞中的一些是面向库的 API 或命令行工具，而非产品的入口点；在将其判定为问题之前，必须逐一确认攻击者控制的输入是否确实能够触及它们。 此外，时间间隔是按照提交之间的时间计算的，而非用户实际体验到的时间；不同版本之间的暴露情况可能存在显著差异，正如 antisamy 的例子所示：尽管两次提交之间仅相隔 13 天，但仍有两个版本在发布时存在该漏洞。
